verifications.claim: Federal income taxes for the 2025 tax year are due on April 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Federal taxes for the 2025 tax year are due on April 15, 2026.'; R7: 'April 15, 2026 is the deadline to file and pay taxes.'; R3: '2026 date April 15 (Wednesday)'; R2/R4: 'April 15' for 2026 taxes.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the due date for 2025 tax year as April 15, 2026.

verifications.claim: The April 15, 2026 deadline applies to filing returns.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'unable to file your individual taxes by April 15, 2026'; R7: 'deadline to file'; R3: 'day on which individual income tax returns are due'; R2/R4: 'filing deadline... April 15'.
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources explicitly confirm April 15, 2026 as the filing deadline.

verifications.claim: The April 15, 2026 deadline applies to paying any taxes owed.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'payment due date... April 15'; 'Taxes are still owed by April 15.'; R4: 'pay any amount due to avoid penalties'; R7: 'deadline to file and pay taxes'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state payment is due April 15, 2026, separate from filing extension.

verifications.claim: The April 15, 2026 deadline applies to submitting extension requests.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'file an extension' by April 15; R2: 'submit the request today [April 15]'; R4: 'request a six-month extension' if not filing by April 15.
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm extension requests must be submitted by April 15, 2026.

verifications.claim: An automatic six-month extension pushes the filing deadline to October 15, 2026.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'file an extension... until October 15, 2026'; R4: 'request a six-month extension... until Thursday, Oct. 15'; R2: 'push the filing deadline to October 15'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources support six-month extension to October 15, 2026 for filing, but describe it as requested/filed rather than explicitly 'automatic', though standard practice.

verifications.claim: October 15, 2026 is the extended deadline to file tax returns.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'until October 15, 2026 to file'; R2: 'push the paperwork deadline to October 15'; R4: 'until Thursday, Oct. 15 to file their tax returns'.
verifications.reasoning: Directly supported by multiple sources as the extended filing deadline.

verifications.claim: An extension grants more time to file paperwork.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'until October 15, 2026 to file your federal and state taxes'; R2: 'push the paperwork deadline'; R4: 'more time to complete your tax forms'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state extension provides additional time for filing.

verifications.claim: An extension does not grant more time to pay taxes owed.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'IRS extension does not move your payment due date'; 'filing a tax extension only delays the return, not the bill'; R4: 'doesn't buy you more time to pay your taxes'.
verifications.reasoning: Directly confirmed by sources that extension applies only to filing, not payment.

verifications.claim: The deadline for Q1 quarterly estimated tax payments is April 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'First payment: April 15'; 'quarterly payments for 2026 are due by... April 15'.
verifications.reasoning: Exactly matches the source for Q1 estimated payments.
